notes.title: Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Official Release
notes.content:
[b][Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Official Release][/b]

Greetings, Adventurers!
Four months have quickly flown by since we launched Early Access on March 21st.

We extend our deepest gratitude to all who participated in the Early Access and provided invaluable feedback. Your unwavering support has been instrumental in polishing the game and crafting a more enjoyable experience for everyone.

And Ta-da! Today, we are thrilled to officially announce that Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears has been released! The released version features not just a new difficulty mode and event missions, but also introduces unique and exciting content exclusive to the Apocalypse difficulty.


【New Difficulty Modes】
◌ 2 new difficulty modes have been added: Easy (Salvation) and Hard (Apocalypse).
◌ The default difficulty is set to Normal (Adversity).
◌ Hard (Apocalypse) difficulty unlocks upon clearing either Easy (Salvation) or Normal (Adversity) mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/0eaf738cc899b94d65200f156d536b446d2e3a8c.png[/img]

【New Event Missions】
◌ 3 new request missions have been added. 
◌ A new Escort mission has been added to the Hard difficulty mode. (Please note that this mission is not available on Easy or Normal difficulty.) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/a9ef11ccddbec9c9e0842e9b68a9ec34989ba2cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/7c32c7f39cc471a062c96d5de41b1df9e6cbdcb0.png[/img]


【Apocalypse Mode: 4 New Heroes Unlocked】
: 4 new heroes boasting unique and potent skills will be available in your battle against the apocalypse.

◌ Astarot: capable of instantaneous healing and dealing massive damage by managing his HP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/e5583d82f2cce0dfb4736f492fe21d2b9ff0e8a3.png[/img]

◌ Astraea: capable of dealing massive damage by utilizing the accumulated contamination level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/bedcca609610999b65ba4c992e4a276111b48699.png[/img]

◌ Tears: specializes in prolonged combat by continuously buffing allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/fb09aa5770d1c283e58e4f03c42027cad3cf0521.png[/img]

◌ Fenrir: Can rapidly recover from damage through high healing and lifesteal, and can apply Mark to combo with allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/9d3958ec3eea08f01deaa04ac7ac61206b43ce69.png[/img]


【Apocalypse Mode: New Enemies Unlocked】
◌ A diverse and formidable legion of enemy monsters have descended upon the battlefield: Prepare to face the ultimate survival challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/3b367a1efefb7b6324b9683c623366aa6be048a1.jpg[/img]


【Apocalypse Mode: New Artifacts and Imprint Stones Unlocked】
◌ The new difficulty mode unlocks a collection of powerful artifacts and Imprint Stones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/09980cefa4f459ecb8d1aa8d8764a3859348eaf6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/621cc9d7d9feb4fccbb4f2c29c6722d057aba36a.png[/img]


【Apocalypse Mode: Artifact Sets Unlocked】
◌ Strategically combine specific artifacts to activate powerful set effects that address your team's shortcomings and maximize their combined potential. It will grant your expedition team a significant advantage on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/3082ac9b94df889f812499659e5c52989f7de869.png[/img]


【Others】
※ Xbox controller support is available.
※ Your progress from Early Access will be carried over to the full release.

Alongside the new content, we have implemented various bug fixes and improvements to ensure the most enjoyable gaming experience possible.
Extensive internal testing has been conducted to ensure a smooth gameplay experience. 
However, if you run into issues while playing the game, please do not hesitate to reach out to us through our official Steam community or Discord server. We promise that we will actively monitor forums and prioritize your feedback!

◌ Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2701350
◌ Discord:  https://discord.gg/pvWn9wGxAY

Once again, we express our sincere gratitude for your interest in our game. 
We invite you to immerse yourself in the world of Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears.
We will be awaiting your adventure!


With Love,
- Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Development Team -

notes.title: v1.1.0.1 Update Patch Note - 07/15/2024
notes.content:
Ⅰ. Summary

◈ 2 new difficulty modes have been added.
◈ In an effort to improve overall game balance, adjustments have been made to hero cards, artifacts, and other elements.
◈ Improvements and bug fixes have been implemented.



Ⅱ. Content

【Difficulty Modes】
◌ 2 new difficulty modes have been added, offering players a total of three distinct difficulty levels.
◌ The default difficulty is set to Normal (Adversity).
◌ Hard (Apocalypse) difficulty unlocks upon clearing either Easy (Salvation) or Normal (Adversity) mode.


◎ Mode Descriptions
◇ Easy (Salvation)
◌ The power of all enemies is decreased.
◌ There will be no reward and EXP penalties when heroes enter an expedition region with a lower level.
◌ Contamination level does not increase upon abandoning an expedition.

◇ Normal (Adversity)
◌ The recommended difficulty for the game.
◌ There will be reward and EXP penalties when heroes enter an expedition region with a lower level.
◌ Contamination level increases by 15 upon abandoning an expedition.

◇ Hard (Apocalypse)
◌ The power of all enemies is increased.
◌ There will be reward and EXP penalties when heroes enter an expedition region with a lower level.
◌ Contamination level increases by 15 upon abandoning an expedition.
◌ 4 new heroes have been unlocked.
◌ New artifacts and Imprint Stones have been unlocked.
◌ Equipping specific combinations of artifacts unlocks set effects.


【Event Missions】
◌ 3 new request missions have been added.
◌ A new Escort mission has been added to the Hard difficulty mode. (Please note that this mission is not available on Easy or Normal difficulty.)


【Expedition】
◌ 12 new random events have been introduced to "?" nodes during expeditions.
◌ 16 new monsters have been introduced across four distinct regions.



III. Balance Adjustment

【Hero Cards】
◌ Several hero cards have received balance adjustments.

◇ Dante
◌ [Exclusive Imprint skill: Exploit Weakness] has been reworked to reduce the DEF of all enemies and gain an immediate turn as it increases its ATK after 1s.

◇ Vena
◌ [Passive skill: Seeker in the Shadows] has been revised in a way it can gain an immediate turn upon dodge.
◌ [Exclusive Imprint skill: Precision Shot] can now inflict damage twice, starting from skill level 1.
◌ Overall skill coefficients of Exclusive Imprint skills have been increased.

◇ Heavenium Buster
◌ [Exclusive Imprint skill: Energy Explosion]'s initial skill cooldown (10s) and HP-based damage have been removed.

◇ Ruanafra
◌ [Exclusive Imprint skill: Will of the Moon]'s skill cooldown has been removed.

◇ Chavana
◌ The duration of [Passive skill: Recurring Night]'s barrier has been extended.
◌ [Active skill: Night's Gaze]'s damage coefficients have been increased.

◇ Luminus
◌ [Normal skill: Soothing Touch] has been reworked to reduce Contamination Levels of all allies immediately.

◇ Hellkite
◌ Skill coefficients for [Active skill: Inner Explosion] have been decreased.


【Artifacts】
◌ Several adjustments have been made to artifact effects.

◇ Holy Sword of Purification
◌ The amount of Contamination Level reduction has been reduced.

◇ Shadow Talonblade
◌ The effect has been revised to trigger on attack.

◇ Ash Wood Staff
◌ Mana restoration amount has been decreased.

◇ Doomaxe
◌ An additional 10% damage will be dealt alongside the original effect.

◇ Grim Scythe
◌ An additional 10% damage will be dealt alongside the original effect.

◇ Saint's Robe
◌ ATK(%) has been increased.

◇ Records of the Dead
◌ The effect has been reworked to mark and exhaust all enemies.

◇ Chains of Hellfire
◌ The effect has been revised to deal piercing bleed damage.

◇ Hourglass of Destiny
◌ The duration of invincibility has been decreased.

◇ Aspectbringer
◌ The effect has been adjusted to increase the amount of Action Power reduction for all enemies and inflict a chance of stun.


【Imprint Stones】
◎ The effects of certain Imprint Stones that increase their abilities each turn have been reduced.
◌ Chaos : Evolution
◌ Chaos : Focus
◌ Chaos : Killing Intent
◌ Chaos : Siphon
◌ Chaos : Drain
◌ Order : Agility
◌ Balance : Reinvigorate


【Spells】
◌ The overall Mana consumption of using spells has been decreased.
◌ Cooldowns for all Spells, except for Chains of Blood, have been decreased.
◌ The Mana coefficients of damage-dealing spells, Magic Missile and Dragon's Breath, have been increased.

◌ The acquisition process for several Spells has been adjusted.
◇ Curse of Vulnerability: 3->2
◇ Curse of Confusion: 3->2
◇ Light's Judgment: 4->3
◇ Block Immunity: 5->4

◌ Spells that previously had a single level can now be upgraded across multiple levels for improved effects.
◇ Chains of Blood: 1->3
◇ Blessing of Swiftness: 1->2
◇ Blessing of Vitality: 1->3
◇ Curse of Despair: 1->3


【Consumables】
◌ The effects of several Consumables have been revised.
◇ Enchanted Reagent: Blessing Remover: Reworked to remove all buffs on an enemy.
◇ Enchanted Reagent: Curse Remover: Reworked to remove all debuffs from an ally.


【Wandering Merchant】
◌ The types and properties of artifacts, Imprint Stones, and Consumables offered by the Wandering Merchant have been revised to better suit players' expedition needs.
◌ The Wandering Merchant now offers a wider variety of items for purchase.
◌ The general price of artifacts has been lowered.
◌ The amount received when selling Imprint Stones and artifacts has been increased.
◌ Enchanted Reagent: Mark/Shock Remover are no longer available from the Wandering Merchant.


【Town Facilities】
◇ Tavern
◌ The initial cost for unlocking Cabin and Pub slots has been lowered.

◇ Hero's Santuary
◌ The maximum cost for recruiting a hero has been capped at 1,000 Soul Stones.



IV. Other information

◌ Gamepad support has been implemented.
◌ End credits have been included.
◌ Exclusive achievements for [Hard: Apocalypse] mode are now available.



V. Improvements

◌ Battle speed has been increased, and overall hit satisfaction has been enhanced.
◌ [Restart Battle] function has been added.
- If your expedition fails and all hero cards are eliminated, pressing the "Restart Battle" button will allow you to retry the challenge.
- When abandoning a battle, you will return to the state before the battle.
◌ Upon abndoning or losing a battle, players can now recover a portion of their loot and return to town.
◌ Escort and Dimensional Rift missions are no longer time-limited. These have been restructured to allow you to encounter a new event mission upon completing the previous one.
◌ Post-game functionality has been expanded. You can now reload save files and continue playing even after defeating the final boss: Asmonelle.
◌ The Encyclopedia can now be accessed directly from the Town's menu bar.
◌ The system has been adjusted to allow you to complete Escort Missions even if some sub-monsters remain, provided that the main boss is eliminated.



VI. Bug Fixes

◌ Various bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.0.6 HotFixes - 04/26/2024
notes.content:
Ⅰ. Summary
◆ Several game balance adjustments have been made.
◆ Improvements and bug fixes have been implemented.



Ⅱ. Details : Balance Adjustment
◆ Hero Card
◎ Several hero cards' skills have been revised.


【Akant】
◌ Gorged (Passive skill): When hit, its Max HP increases for the rest of this battle.


【Heavenium Buster】
◌ Supercharged Magic Cannon (Active skill): The skill now deals percing Area-of-Effect (AoE) damage, instead of normal damage. Additionally, the bonus damage dealt for each buff removed has been changed from piercing to normal damage.
◌ Energy Explosion (Exclusive imprint skill): The skill's cast time has been removed, resulting in a longer cooldown.


【Luminus】
◌ Song of Forest (Passive skill): On this card's turn, remove 1 debuff from all allies. (Got rid of "with 25% chance" from the previous skill information)

◌ The Great Spirit's Blessing (Passive skill)
* Before: Increase Max HP of all allies by 20%.
* After: Whenever an ally takes a turn, apply 1 Reinvigorate Crest.

◌ Light of Recurrence (Active skill): Crest functionality has been reworked to purify an ally's Contamination Levels when activated, replacing the previous HP heal.
◌ Light of Resurrection (Active skill): The functionality of the existing resurrection ability has been expanded to incorporate an HP healing effect for an ally.


【Chavana】
◌ Recurring Night (Passive skill): The trigger for creating Shield has been changed from "On command" to "Whenever the card gets a turn."
* After: Whenever the card gets a turn, create a Shield that absorbs damage up to 20% of Max HP for 3 s.

◌ Accumulate Rage (Normal skill): Upgrading this skill will increase the Action Power.
◌ Unveil Moonlight (Active skill): Upgrading this skill will extend the duration of the Mark application.


【Hellkite】
◌ Inner Explosion (Active skill): The skill's cast time has been removed, resulting in longer cooldown.
◌ Disruption (Exclusive imprint skill): Deal Burst Damage (Previously Piercing Damage) to all bleeding enemies.


【Gracia】
◌ Divine Light (Active skill): Upgrading this skill will extend the duration of Silence application.





◆ Artifact
◎ Talisman Rework: Talisman effects have been reworked. Now, all Talisman items will trigger their effects every 5 start of turns.

【Flames of Punishment】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers every 10 -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Deal 20% piercing bleed damage to all enemies over 4 s. (Instantly kill near-death enemies.)
◌ Revised version: Inflict 10% damage on an enemy, and deal 60% additional piercing damage when an enemy is bleeding.


【Dendroid Doll】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers every 4 -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Reduce Status Resist of all enemies by 25% for 4 s.
◌ Revised version: Inflict 10% damage on an enemy, and deal 60% piercing damage when an enemy is marked.


【Jack Spencer's Skeletal Hand】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers every 4 -> 5 start of turns


【Banner of Glory】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the start of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Remove all debuffs on all allies with a 5% chance.
◌ Revised version: Remove 3 debuffs on all allies.


【Goblin Head】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the start of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Remove all buffs on all enemies with a 5% chance.
◌ Revised version: Inflict 10% damage on an enemy, and deal 60% piercing damage when an enemy is exhausted.


【Golden Toad】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the start of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Remove Contamination Levels of all allies by 100 with a 2% chance.
◌ Revised version: Remove Contamination Levels of all allies by 3.


【Barrier Stone】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the start of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Restore 200 Mana with a 2% chance.
◌ Revised version: Restore 5 Mana.


【Censer of Repose】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the start of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Heal all allies for 100% of Max HP with a 2% chance.
◌ Revised version: Heal all allies for 5% of Max HP.


【Hourglass of Destiny】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the start of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Make all allies invincible for 2 s with a 5% chance.
◌ Revised version: Make all allies invincible for 1 s.


【Aspectbringer】
◌ Trigger Condition: Triggers at the end of turn -> 5 start of turns
◌ Original version: Restore 0-10 Energy to each ally.
◌ Revised version: Reduce Energy of all allies by 2.5%.




◆ Imprint Stone
◎ The effects of several Common Imprint Stones have been revised.
※ Note: Imprint Stone skill information is indicated by a numerical percentage(%) within parentheses. Rarity levels are categorized as Common, Uncommon, and Rare.


【Chaos : Evolution】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, increase Block Chance by [1/1.5/1.75]% for the rest of this expedition.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase Block Chance by [6/12/15%].


【Chaos : Focus】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, increase Crit Chance by [0.5/1/1.25%] for the rest of this expedition.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase Crit Chance by [3/6/7.5%].


【Chaos : Killing Intent】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, increase Reflect Chance by [0.75/1.25/1.5%] for the rest of this expedition.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase Reflect Chance by [4/8/10%].


【Chaos : Siphon】
◌ Original version: On kill, increase Max HP by [4.5/7.5/9%] for the rest of this expedition.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase Max HP by [4/8/10%].


【Chaos : Drain】
◌ Original version: On kill, increase ATK by [2/2.7/3%] for the rest of this expedition.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase ATK by [3/6/7.5%].


【Chaos : Devour】
◌ Original version: On kill, increase DEF by [20/27/30%] for the rest of this expedition.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase DEF by [10/20/25%].


【Chaos : Berserk】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Crit Chance by [4.5/6.5/7.5%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Crit Chance by [6/12/15%].


【Chaos : Brilliance】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Skill Speed by [10/20/40%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Skill Speed by [10/20/40%].


【Chaos : Ghost】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Dodge Chance by [4/6/7%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Dodge Chance by [6/12/15%].


【Chaos : Haste】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Attack Speed by [5/10/13%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Attack Speed by [6/12/15%].


【Chaos : Delirium】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Reflect Chance by [6/8/9%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Reflect Chance by [8/16/20%].


【Order : Invincible】
◌ Original version: Upon attacked, if the card's HP is [35/45/50%] or lower, grant invincibility for 1 s. (This effect is applied every second.)
◌ Revised version: [Miracle] When near death, grant invincibility to all allies for [1/2/2.5] s. (This effect is applied every second.)


【Order : Iron Will】
◌ Original version: When near death, if HP is [40/20/10%] or higher and one hit leads to near death, resurrect with 1 HP. (This effect is applied every 6 seconds.)
◌ Revised version: [Resurrection] When near death, resurrects the card by [10/20/25%] of its Max HP. (This effect is applied every 6 seconds.)


【Order : Determination】
◌ Original version: When hit, if this card's HP is [35/55/65%] or lower, remove 1 debuff. (This effect is applied only once regardless of number of hits.)
◌ Revised version: [Mana] On kill, restore [4/8/10] Mana. (This effect is applied only once regardless of number of hits.)


【Order : Pulverization】
◌ Original version: When attack, if the target's HP is [65/45/35%] or higher, remove 1 buff. (This effect is applied only once regardless of number of hits.)
◌ Revised version: Upon critical hit, reduce Contamination Levels by [1/2/3]. (This effect is applied only once regardless of number of hits.)


【Order : Agility】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, [6/10/12%] chance to gain 1 Dodge Opening.
◌ Revised version: Whenever this card takes a turn, increase Dodge Chance by [3/6/7.5%].


【Order : Critical】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, [8/12/14%] chance to gain 1 Crit Opening.
◌ Revised version: [Order : Onslaught] Increase ATK by [6/12/15%].


【Order : Crit Damage】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Crit Damage by [25/50/75%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Crit Damage by [25/50/75%].


【Order : Block】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, [10/20/25%] chance to gain 1 Block Opening.
◌ Revised version: [Order : Life] Increase Max HP by [8/16/20%].


【Order : Reflect】
◌ Original version: On this card's turn, [9/15/18%] chance to gain 1 Reflect Opening.
◌ Revised version: [Order : Iron Wall] Increase DEF by [20/40/50%].


【Order : Healing】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Recover Amount by [25/60/75%].
◌ Revised version: Increase Exhaust Resist by [20/40/50%] and Recover Amount by [15/30/40%].


【Balance : Destruction】
◌ Original version: On command, apply 1 Destruction Crest on all enemies with a [10/20/25%] chance.
◌ Revised version: Whenever the card gets a turn, grant 1 Destruction Crest to all enemies with a [10/20/25%] chance.


【Balance : Recovery】
◌ Original version: When hit, if this card's HP is 50% or lower, restore [10/16/20%] of Max HP over 10 s. (This effect is applied only once regardless of number of hits.)
◌ Revised version: When hit, recover HP by [4/8/10%] of Max HP over 1 s. (This effect is applied only once regardless of number of hits.)


【Balance : Rage】
◌ Original version: On attack, if this card's HP is at or under 50%, Deal [20/40/50%] burst damage to an enemy. (This effect is applied every second.)
◌ Revised version: When hit, increase ATK by [4/8/10%]. (This effect is applied every second.)


【Balance : Sturdy】
◌ Original version: At the start of battle, increase Block Chance by [7/11/13%].
◌ Revised version: [Balance : Sturdy] Increase Block Chance by [10/20/25%].


【Balance : Protection】
◌ Original version: When hit, if its HP is at or under 50%, create a Shield by [25/35/40%] of Max HP for 6 s. (This effect is applied only once during the battle.)
◌ Revised version: When hit, create a Shield by [10/20/25%] of Max HP for 4 s. (This effect is applied every 4 seconds.)


【Balance : Thorns】
◌ Original version: When hit, Deal [15/25/30%] damage to an enemy.
◌ Revised version: [Reinvigorate] Whenever this card takes a turn, grant 1 Reinvigorate Crest to all allies with a [20/40/50%] chance.


【Balance : Iron Wall】
◌ Original version: When hit, deal [30/50/60%] charging damage to an enemy.
◌ Revised version: [Wisdom] Whenever this card takes a turn, reduce cooldown by [0.5/1/1.5] s.


【Balance : Counterattack】
◌ Original version: When hit, deal damage equal to [2.5/3.5/4]% of Max HP to the enemy.
◌ Revised version: [Seal] On kill, reduce Contamination Levels by [2/4/5].




◆ Spell
◎ Spell Mana Reduction: Mana consumption for spells beyond level 3 has been decreased.

◌ Spell Level 1: Consume 20 Mana
◌ Spell Level 2: Consume 25 Mana
◌ Spell Level 3: Consume 35 -> 30 Mana
◌ Spell Level 4: Consume 60 -> 35 Mana
◌ Spell Level 5: Consume 75 -> 40 Mana



◆ Event Mission
◎ The balance of several Dimensional Rift and Escort missions has been adjusted by lowering difficulty.

◎ Dimensional Rift: Sentinel of Darkness
◌ Kraken of the Depths' recovery amount and bleed damage have been reduced.
◌ Kraken Tentacles' active skill has been removed, and passive skill has been revised.

◎ Dimensional Rift: Cruel Butcher
◌ The playstyle of Helberus of Carnage has been revamped.

◎ Escort: Wandering Merchant's Carriage
◌ The region effect, <Murder'em!>, that previously summoned Goblins has been removed.
◌ A casting time has been added to Ogre Bandit's Pyromancer Bandit summon skill.
◌ The damage dealt by Horned Ogre Bandit and Orcan Bandit Boss has been decreased.

◎ Escort: Legendary Spear, Grengar
◌ The regional effect, <Transform>, that buffed monsters' Max HP and ATK has been removed.

◎ Escort: Master of the Holy Sword
◌ The region effect, <Deathscream>, that caused monsters to inflict damage when near death is no longer present.
◌ The region effect, <Unstable Test Subject>, has been reworked to now inflict bleed damage.
◌ A passive skill of Berthe that granted invincibility to himself has been revised to remove bleed effects from all allies.



◆ Boss Battle
◌ Players will now receive increased EXP rewards upon clearing Boss Battles.
◌ Boss Battles have been implemented into Extermination missions as well.





III. Improvements

◌ Hero's Area of Effect (AoE) skill sound effects have been adjusted to prevent overlapping during battle. Now, each sound effect will play only once.
◌ Skill descriptions in several languages have been shortened to improve readability.
◌ Terminology consistency has been improved by revising "Evade" to "Dodge" throughout the game.
◌ "Amplification" has been replaced with "Critical Damage" within the game to avoid player confusion.




IV. Bug Fixes

◌ Resolved an issue where the Contamination Level of monsters increased when a hero got destroyed.
◌ Revised an issue where players could not obtain particular type of artifact.
◌ Icon conflict issue addressed: The ally synergy icon for Tavern facility-using heroes no longer overlaps with the facility use icon on the World Map.
◌ Artifact activation buffs for Saint's Robe and Golden Shield are now correctly applied even when a hero card is destroyed in a battle.
◌ Fixed a bug where the Destruction Crest icon does not disappear during the battle occasionally.
◌ Viewing details of other hero cards after reviewing an escort hero card no longer causes the skill information of the previous hero card to disappear.
◌ The stage level for extermination missions is now correctly generated.
◌ Inaccurate information within hero skill upgrade tooltip descriptions for various languages has been corrected.
◌ Text overlapping within the [Details] description window for hero cards in Spanish language settings has been addressed.
◌ Incorrect language display fixed in German language settings: Text is now correctly displayed in German from the Tavern, and no longer shows Korean text.

notes.title: Letter from the Dev Team
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,
This is Director Jay from Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears development team.


A week has already flown by since our Early Access launch, and it still feels unreal!
We are incredibly grateful to every adventurer who has embarked on this journey with us.
Your passionate thoughts, insightful opinions, and heartfelt feedback are truly invaluable.

Initially, we considered replying directly to your amazing reviews on our official Steam and Discord community pages.
However, we decided an official announcement would be more effective, ensuring everyone is informed about our plans and deeply appreciative of your participation in the Early Access phase.



◆ The challenge of the game intensifies as contamination levels rise.
- Yes, the game gets more difficult as contamination level increases. However, contamination spread from the Black Tears also offer a path to considerable power.
Gora, a prominent boss from the Kingdom of Kerkin, succumbed to this allure, becoming consumed by the Black Tear's strength.
This led to his downfall as a king, perpetually seeking even greater power from the Black Tears. Similarly, the rising contamination level not only signifies a more challenging experience but also increases your hero's abilities.

We acknowledge that managing contamination levels has presented difficulties for many players. The challenges escalate when contamination surpasses 50%, inflicting damage on nearby allies and potentially wiping out your entire team at max level.

Our initial intention for the contamination level system was to offer strategic advantages during battles, not to be a source of stress. 
However, we recognized that the system's negativity outweighs its benefits. Consequently, we are exploring revisions as outlined below:

◌ Implement positive effects from contamination buildup at an earlier stage than currently implemented. Besides, activate the contamination spread to allies at a higher contamination level, compared to the existing threshold.



◆ High-risk of expedition failure
- We understand the frustration of losing gathered resources due to expedition failure. 
Yet, we believe this system offers a thrilling experience, allowing players to define their path within the map and approach battles with cautious strategy.
Furthermore, an ultimate success of an expedition amplifies the sense of accomplishment.

Expedition failure is undeniably linked to accumulating contamination levels. Therefore, our initial focus for revision will be adjusting the contamination system. Subsequently, we will explore options to refine expedition difficulty and decrease failure risks.



◆ Hero card balance and synergy improvements
- We have identified some challenges in showcasing hero card synergies effectively. 
In certain cases, hero cards may struggle to manage their ever-accumulating contamination levels by taunting themselves. To address these concerns, we are planning a balance update that will adjust several hero cards. 

Furthermore, we are actively exploring ways to enhance the abilities of supporter-type heroes, making them more valuable during expeditions.
A comprehensive update outlining these details will be provided as soon as possible.



◆ Equipment customization and artifact diversification
- We understand the desire for a system that allows players to equip each hero card with unique equipment. While such a system is not currently in development, we recognize the value of diversified customization options.

The existing Divination Hall system utilizing Imprinting Stones already provides a platform to customize hero abilities. We hope players can try different types of Imprinting Stones based on their enemy types, boss encounters, and overall deck synergy.

Moving forward, we will be focusing on adding a wider variety of Imprinting Stones to the game. 
This will provide players with more options to tailor hero abilities and unlock new strategic possibilities. 
Additionally, we are exploring ways to improve the functionality of underutilized Imprinting Stones and enhance the overall balance between artifacts and specific hero card combinations. These changes will be reflected in upcoming balance updates, with a focus on promoting strong synergies between artifacts and specific hero combinations.



◆ Adding more content and engaging events
- We are committed to meticulously reviewing and brainstorming diverse ideas to introduce refreshing and entertaining sub-missions and events that will keep your expedition gameplay exciting. 
Additionally, we aim to develop streamlined and entertaining gameplay content that allows players to take a break from the lengthy and arduous battles.



◆ Controller support
- Controller support for the game is a high priority for our team. We are actively working on its implementation and will provide updates as soon as it is available.



◆ Introducing a dynamic difficulty mode
- Based on your valuable feedback, we are thrilled to announce the development of a "difficult mode" for the game. This will go beyond simply increasing enemy stats by offering a more engaging experience. Difficulty will increase based on your in-game progress (weeks played) and by introducing deeper roguelike elements.

Our goal is not to create artificial difficulty by adjusting numerical values or balancing. 
Instead, we want the difficulty to adapt to your choices.

To prepare for these challenges, we are planning to introduce new heroes, artifacts, and Imprinting Stones, making deck building and hero recruitment a more enjoyable and rewarding process. We believe these additions will significantly enhance your gameplay experience. 

A detailed developer note outlining the development roadmap for the difficulty mode will be provided as soon as possible. Stay tuned for further updates!



◆ Is it truly a deck-building game?
- We understand there may be some confusion regarding the genre of our game. 
Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears is a unique blend of roguelike, RPG, and deck-building elements.

While the deck-building mechanics may not be entirely traditional, the game offers strategic depth. 
Players will need to carefully consider whether to prioritize hero recruitment or town development, creating a personalized gameplay experience. We are committed to further refining the deck-building aspects of the game, empowering players to develop their own unique playstyles through strategic decision-making.



Lastly, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has participated in the Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Early Access!

Your valuable feedback, heartfelt reviews, and passionate suggestions are instrumental in the ongoing development of the project.

Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts!
We look forward to sharing more exciting news and content in the future. 

Until then, take care!



Sincerely,
Jay from Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears

notes.title: v1.0.0.2 Hot Fixes #2 - 03/22/2024
notes.content:

- The game language will now automatically match your Steam client's default language.

notes.title: Known Issues: Language Settings in Early Access
notes.content:
[b][Known Issues: Language Settings in Early Access][/b]

Dear adventurers,
We are aware of a language issue that has arisen following the launch of Early Access.
We apologize that the game is currently displaying in Korean, regardless of your PC's default language settings. 

We are scheduled to revise this issue and make an update today.
Players who have accessed the game prior to today's update are kindly requested to follow these steps to resolve this issue.

◆ Recommended Solutions ◆
1. Launch the game
2. On the main page, access the Settings menu on the bottom right side of the screen
3. Select your preferred language from the available options

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/d7d3e099c28757913bcc7fc449ce21f76e017b3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/7e7a6ae35659623a4871c4388604f4e29e1a2362.png[/img]

Alternatively, you can adjust the language settings through the town screen.
1. Press the "ESC" key
2. Click the first button on the top menu
3. Choose the desired language

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/43d4aec55e98f51b9658475530f45768b3308b7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892406/05d271936d68155e4bfdb300d447b7be7a6cab60.png[/img]

Important Notes:
◌ Changing the language will result in a return to the title screen.
◌ Language adjustments are unavailable during battles.


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Should you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to leave us a comment on the post.

notes.title: Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Official Early Access Announcement
notes.content:
[b][Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Official Early Access Announcement][/b]

Hello, adventurers!
The Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears development team is thrilled to announce the official launch of the game in Early Access!

We are excited to invite you to embark on this journey with us and provide valuable feedback to shape the future of Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears.
Your input will be instrumental in helping us create the best possible gaming experience.

Should you encounter any issues during your adventures, please do not hesitate to reach out.
You can leave detailed messages or suggestions on our official Steam or Discord community.

- Thursday, March 21st, 2024 @ 4:00 PM KST

◆ How to participate
- Visit the Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears Store page on Steam and log in with your Steam ID.
- Purchase the game and click on "PLAY"
- Download and play Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears from your library.

◆ Early Access Discount : $11.99 USD (20% off)

◆ Official Discord Community
https://discord.gg/pvWn9wGxAY


Lastly, stay connected with the latest Dragon Chronicles: Black Tears game news, updates, and events by joining our official Discord server.

Once again, we are incredibly grateful for your interest and look forward to a continued journey with our adventurers, both during Early Access and beyond!
